summary: Vilas County, WI lookout listed as gone; sources give only county, a 1,683 ft mapped point and the status, with no build or removal history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains on the site

evidence.supports: listed as gone on the Wisconsin lookout list
Flambeau Ridge in Chippewa County is a separate tower, listed as standing
mapping database lists an observation tower named Flambeau Lookout Tower
mapped point is tagged as an observation tower
OSM point sits at nearly the same coordinates as the lookout list entry (45.99621 north, 89.84492 west)
point is about 1,683 feet above sea level
evidence.quote: at an elevation of 1683 ft MSL

evidence.supports: in 2015 the DNR announced the towers were being removed
evidence.quote: The DNR announced late last week the fire towers used to spot out of control fires were being eliminated.

evidence.quote: It can be seen on the USGS 1:24K topographic map Fence Lake, WI

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The OSM node carries no status tag, so 'standing' in data/sources/osm.json is a default, not a source statement; the lookout list says gone and is used.

sources.title: State fire towers to leave the landscape

notes_for_editor: Only the county, the lookout list's gone status and a mapped point are sourced. No build date, builder, staffing, removal date or site condition appears in any source read; the Forest Lookouts page for Flambeau has no text beyond the county line. Do not confuse with the Flambeau Ridge tower in Chippewa County, which the same list marks standing. The record elevation 513 m matches TopoQuest 1683 ft. The record's status 'gone' stands. Suggested checks: Vilas County Historical Society; Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory and DNR forestry archives, searching under both the Conservation Department and Conservation Commission names; 1930s-40s Vilas County newspapers.
